name: Sneed
summary: Deep in the Deadmines, Sneed directs the Defias Brotherhood’s timber work. From the Mast Room, he pilots a heavy shredder of his own design, cutting lumber for Edwin VanCleef’s secret juggernaut.

sections.title: The Defias Lumbermaster
sections.body: The Defias Brotherhood draws most of its members from human stonemasons and laborers. Yet Edwin VanCleef brought Sneed in for his engineering skill and ruthless efficiency. A warship needs skilled trades, and Sneed directs the timber work in the Mast Room beside the underground rail network. There, wood is felled, cut, and shaped for VanCleef’s colossal dreadnaught.

sections.title: Industrial Brutality
sections.body: Sneed cares about costs and quotas, whatever the consequences. From a custom shredder fitted with oversized buzz saws, he directs the work. Its blades turn raw trunks into shipbuilding timber in seconds. When intruders corner him, Sneed uses the machine’s armor to grind them down. If the shredder fails, he scrambles from the wreckage and fights barehanded.

faq.answer: Sneed works for Edwin VanCleef as a goblin engineer and lumbermaster. He oversees the Deadmines timber work for the Defias juggernaut.
Sneed works in the Mast Room, a lumber mill chamber along the mining tracks in the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook.

faq.q: Why is a goblin working for the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Edwin VanCleef needed specialized industrial knowledge and quick results for his secret warship. He hired mercenary goblins like Sneed, who care little for politics or ethics when the coin is good.

faq.q: What is Sneed piloting in battle?
faq.answer: Sneed pilots Sneed’s Shredder, a heavy, saw-wielding bipedal machine he built to harvest and slice timber at great speed.

faq.q: What happens when his shredder is destroyed?
faq.answer: Destroying the shredder does not end the fight. Sneed climbs from its wreckage and keeps fighting intruders on foot.

faq.q: What is Sneed building timber for?
faq.answer: Sneed’s timber travels downstream to Ironclad Cove, where the Brotherhood is assembling a massive warship to strike back at Stormwind.

angles.text: Sneed’s custom shredder shows goblin craft at work: efficient, heavily armed, and built for speed beyond standard safety limits.
As a gnome, you may recognize goblin ingenuity in Sneed’s machine: loud, hazardous, and built without regard for comfort or lasting structure.
As an Alliance member, you can cripple the Defias Brotherhood’s shipbuilding by stopping Sneed’s timber supply to Ironclad Cove.
